title: Finance – Torrens Gulf Water
description: For the Torrens Gulf Water finance team. Ask about billed revenue by quarter, region, tariff and customer type; overdue bills and debt; concession and hardship; main break repair costs; River Murray pumping energy costs; and what leaks and meter under-registration cost. Synthetic demo data: bills 2025-Q1 to 2026-Q3, daily data to 12 Nov 2026.

question: Which regions have the highest overdue rate in the latest settled quarter?
How many hardship and concession customers did we bill last quarter?
What has the Unley DMA 7 leak cost us so far?
What did we bill each quarter, and how much is overdue?
What have main break repairs cost us by month?

Gold, one row per DMA per day (1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026): inflow, billed volume, non-revenue water (NRW), minimum night flow against the DMA's own baseline and against all 240 DMAs, the leak alert, main breaks and weather. Owns the leak alert rule.

THE leak alert. True when a full 14-day window shows mnf_vs_peer_ratio_14d >= 1.06 AND nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp_14d >= 0.75: night flow per 1,000 connections at least 6 percent above the peer median and NRW at least 0.75 points above it, both averaged over 14 days. Use it for every question about whether, where or since when a DMA is leaking.

A noisier single-day check, not the leak alert: mnf_per_1000_conn >= 1.25 x the peer median AND nrw_pct >= 1.25 x the peer median on the day. It is often false inside a leak alert, so never use it to say whether a DMA is leaking.
Water main breaks recorded in the DMA on the day.
Major main breaks (300 or more customers affected) in the DMA on the day.
The DMA's own baseline: average min_night_flow_kl_per_hour over the 28 days before this day, kL per hour.
Minimum night flow per 1,000 connections, kL per hour. Use it, not raw night flow, to compare DMAs of different size.

min_night_flow_kl_per_hour divided by mnf_baseline_28d. Above 1 means night flow is up on the DMA's own recent baseline. A slow leak lifts the baseline too, so this only shows onset; it is not the leak alert.
mnf_per_1000_conn divided by peer_median_mnf_per_1000_conn, on the day.
Average of mnf_vs_peer_ratio over the 14 days up to and including this day. One of the two leak_alert tests.
nrw_pct minus peer_median_nrw_pct on the day, in percentage points.
Average of nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp over the 14 days up to and including this day. One of the two leak_alert tests.
Non-revenue water on the day in megalitres: inflow_ml minus billed_ml.
Average nrw_pct over the 28 days up to and including this day (fewer days before 28 Jan 2025).
Median mnf_per_1000_conn across all 240 DMAs on the same day.
Median nrw_pct across all 240 DMAs on the same day, about 7 percent.

content:
## PURPOSE
- Finance agent for Torrens Gulf Water: billed revenue, overdue bills and debt, concession and hardship, main break repair costs, River Murray pumping energy costs, and the cost of lost water.
- Synthetic demo utility; bills run 2025-Q1 to 2026-Q3, daily data to 12 Nov 2026.

## DISAMBIGUATION
- "Revenue" means billed revenue (total_billed_aud), not cash received.
- "This quarter" or "last quarter" means the latest quarter billed, 2026-Q3.
- Payment questions (paid, overdue, debt, overdue rate) use the latest quarter with paid or overdue bills, 2026-Q2. Every 2026-Q3 bill is still issued (not yet due), so its overdue figures are zero by construction, not good news: say so.
- Dates are relative to the data, never current_date().

## DATA QUALITY NOTES
- overdue_rate, avg_bill_aud, avg_billed_kl and avg_meter_bench_error_pct are per-row ratios: re-aggregate from the sums, never average them.
- The billing table cannot say how many hardship bills are overdue: hardship and overdue are separate counts.
- About 1 percent of bills in every settled quarter are still issued; count them as unpaid, not overdue.
- Daily cost data for 2026-Q4 is partial (to 12 Nov 2026).

## CONSTRAINTS
- Value water lost to leaks (real losses) at the River Murray pumping energy cost per ML over the same days; value meter under-registration (apparent losses) at the usage price per kL. Call both estimates; pumping energy is a floor that leaves out treatment and water costs.

## Instructions you must follow when providing summaries
- Money in AUD, as $k or $m for large sums; state the quarters or dates used.
- Round volumes to 1 decimal place and percentages to 2.

question: What was billed revenue by quarter?
sql:
SELECT g.bill_quarter_label AS quarter, SUM(g.bills) AS bills,
  ROUND(SUM(g.usage_charge_aud) / 1e6, 2) AS usage_aud_m, ROUND(SUM(g.fixed_charge_aud) / 1e6, 2) AS fixed_aud_m,
  ROUND(SUM(g.wastewater_charge_aud) / 1e6, 2) AS wastewater_aud_m, ROUND(SUM(g.total_billed_aud) / 1e6, 2) AS total_billed_aud_m
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g
GROUP BY g.bill_quarter_label
ORDER BY quarter

question: How did revenue by tariff compare with the same quarter last year?
sql:
WITH q AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(s.bill_quarter) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly s) AS latest)
SELECT g.tariff_code, g.holder_type,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.bill_quarter = q.latest THEN g.total_billed_aud END) / 1e6, 2) AS latest_quarter_aud_m,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.bill_quarter = ADD_MONTHS(q.latest, -12) THEN g.total_billed_aud END) / 1e6, 2) AS year_earlier_aud_m
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g CROSS JOIN q
GROUP BY g.tariff_code, g.holder_type
ORDER BY g.tariff_code

question: How many hardship and concession bills were there by region last quarter?
sql:
SELECT g.bill_quarter_label AS quarter, g.region_name, SUM(g.bills) AS bills,
  SUM(g.hardship_bills) AS hardship_bills, ROUND(SUM(g.hardship_bills) * 100.0 / SUM(g.bills), 2) AS hardship_pct,
  SUM(g.concession_bills) AS concession_bills, ROUND(SUM(g.concession_bills) * 100.0 / SUM(g.bills), 2) AS concession_pct
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g
WHERE g.bill_quarter = (SELECT MAX(s.bill_quarter) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly s)
GROUP BY g.bill_quarter_label, g.region_name
ORDER BY hardship_pct DESC

question: What has the water lost to leaks cost, valued at the pumping energy cost?
sql:
SELECT n.dma_id, n.dma_name, MIN(n.obs_date) AS first_alert_day, MAX(n.obs_date) AS last_alert_day, COUNT(*) AS alert_days,
  ROUND(SUM(n.inflow_ml * GREATEST(n.nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp, 0) / 100), 1) AS ml_lost_above_peer,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud) / NULLIF(SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 0), 2) AS pumping_energy_aud_per_ml,
  ROUND(SUM(n.inflow_ml * GREATEST(n.nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp, 0) / 100) * SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud)
    / NULLIF(SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 0), 0) AS est_cost_aud
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n
JOIN adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily o ON o.obs_date = n.obs_date
WHERE n.leak_alert
GROUP BY n.dma_id, n.dma_name
usage_guidance: Real losses are valued at the River Murray pumping energy cost per ML on the same alert days: an estimate and a floor.

question: What did main break repairs cost by month and pipe material?
sql:
SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', b.failed_on) AS DATE) AS month, b.pipe_material, COUNT(*) AS breaks,
  ROUND(SUM(b.repair_cost_aud), 0) AS repair_cost_aud
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_main_breaks b
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 4 DESC

question: What did River Murray pumping energy cost each quarter?
sql:
SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(o.obs_date), '-Q', QUARTER(o.obs_date)) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 0) AS ml_pumped,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud), 0) AS energy_cost_aud,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud) / NULLIF(SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 0), 2) AS cost_aud_per_ml
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
usage_guidance: 2026-Q4 is partial (to 12 Nov 2026). Recompute cost per ML from the sums.

question: What are apparent losses from meter under-registration worth at the usage price, by quarter?
sql:
SELECT g.bill_quarter_label AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(g.est_meter_unregistered_kl) / 1000, 1) AS ml_unregistered,
  ROUND(SUM(g.usage_charge_aud) / SUM(g.billed_kl), 3) AS usage_price_aud_per_kl,
  ROUND(SUM(g.est_meter_unregistered_kl) * SUM(g.usage_charge_aud) / SUM(g.billed_kl), 0) AS est_value_aud
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g
GROUP BY g.bill_quarter_label
ORDER BY quarter
usage_guidance: Apparent losses are valued at the usage price per kL: an estimate.

question: What is the overdue rate and overdue debt by region in the latest quarter with payment data?
sql:
SELECT g.bill_quarter_label AS quarter, g.region_name, SUM(g.bills) AS bills, SUM(g.overdue_bills) AS overdue_bills,
  ROUND(SUM(g.overdue_bills) * 100.0 / SUM(g.bills), 2) AS overdue_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(g.overdue_aud), 0) AS overdue_aud
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g
WHERE g.bill_quarter = (SELECT MAX(s.bill_quarter) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly s WHERE s.paid_bills + s.overdue_bills > 0)
GROUP BY g.bill_quarter_label, g.region_name
ORDER BY overdue_rate_pct DESC
usage_guidance: Payment questions use the latest quarter with paid or overdue bills (2026-Q2); every 2026-Q3 bill is still issued.

sql: gold_customer_billing_quarterly.bill_quarter = (SELECT MAX(s.bill_quarter) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly s WHERE s.paid_bills + s.overdue_bills > 0)

measures.display_name: Pumping energy cost per ML over a period

question: How much did we bill in total in 2026-Q3?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(g.total_billed_aud), 0) AS billed_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g WHERE g.bill_quarter_label = '2026-Q3'

question: What did main break repairs cost in 2025?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(b.repair_cost_aud), 0) AS repair_cost_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_main_breaks b WHERE YEAR(b.failed_on) = 2025

question: How did total billing in 2026-Q3 compare with 2025-Q3?

content: SELECT g.bill_quarter_label, ROUND(SUM(g.total_billed_aud), 0) AS billed_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g WHERE g.bill_quarter_label IN ('2025-Q3', '2026-Q3') GROUP BY g.bill_quarter_label ORDER BY 1

question: What did River Murray pumping energy cost in 2025?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud), 0) AS energy_cost_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily o WHERE YEAR(o.obs_date) = 2025

question: What was our overdue rate last quarter?

content: SELECT g.bill_quarter_label, ROUND(SUM(g.overdue_bills) * 100.0 / SUM(g.bills), 2) AS overdue_rate_pct FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g WHERE g.bill_quarter = (SELECT MAX(s.bill_quarter) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly s WHERE s.paid_bills + s.overdue_bills > 0) GROUP BY g.bill_quarter_label

evaluation_note: Must answer for 2026-Q2 (the latest quarter with payment status) and say 2026-Q3 bills are not yet due. Reject an answer of 0 percent for 2026-Q3.

question: What has the Unley DMA 7 leak cost in pumping energy so far?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(n.inflow_ml * GREATEST(n.nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp, 0) / 100) * SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud) / SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 0) AS est_cost_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n JOIN adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily o ON o.obs_date = n.obs_date WHERE n.dma_id = 'DMA-ADS-007' AND n.leak_alert

question: Which region billed the most in 2026-Q3?

content: SELECT g.region_name, ROUND(SUM(g.total_billed_aud), 0) AS billed_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g WHERE g.bill_quarter_label = '2026-Q3' GROUP BY g.region_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average standard residential (RES-1) bill in 2026-Q3?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(g.total_billed_aud) / SUM(g.bills), 2) AS avg_bill_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g WHERE g.bill_quarter_label = '2026-Q3' AND g.tariff_code = 'RES-1'

question: What share of 2026-Q2 bills went to hardship customers?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(g.hardship_bills) * 100.0 / SUM(g.bills), 2) AS hardship_pct FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g WHERE g.bill_quarter_label = '2026-Q2'

question: How much was overdue on 2026-Q2 bills?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(g.overdue_aud), 0) AS overdue_aud FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly g WHERE g.bill_quarter_label = '2026-Q2'
